description: Source code for the Android AudioPlayer class, implementing audio playback functionality with support for buffers, seeking, and callbacks.

classes.name: AudioPlayer
classes.description: Class implementing audio playback with buffer management, seeking, and callback handling.

methods.name: setSource
methods.description: Sets the media source for playback.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts playback, initializing audio sink or track.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback, optionally playing pending samples.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the player, releasing resources and buffers.

methods.name: AudioCallback
methods.description: Static callback invoked for audio data requests.

methods.name: isSeeking
methods.description: Returns whether a seek operation is in progress.

methods.name: reachedEOS
methods.description: Checks if end of stream has been reached.

methods.name: setPlaybackRatePermille
methods.description: Sets the playback rate in permille.

methods.name: AudioSinkCallback
methods.description: Static callback for AudioSink to request more data.

methods.name: fillBuffer
methods.description: Fills the provided buffer with audio data from the source.

methods.name: getNumFramesPendingPlayout
methods.description: Returns the number of frames pending to be played out.

methods.name: getRealTimeUs
methods.description: Returns the current real-time position in microseconds.

methods.name: getMediaTimeUs
methods.description: Returns the current media time in microseconds.

methods.name: getMediaTimeMapping
methods.description: Provides mapping between real time and media time.

methods.name: seekTo
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in microseconds.
